meaning:
ἀποστοματίζω
(στόμα),
1. In cl., to speak from memory, to dic­tate to a pupil (Plat.).
2. In late Gk., to catechize, question: Luk.11:53 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him;
